name: focus_far_cursor
about: Right-click the top face of a block near x = 1,000,008 with a stone block in hand. The true hit fraction in x is about 0.547. 1.7.10 computes (float)hitX - (float)x, and float has a 0.0625 ulp there, so the fraction becomes 0.5625 and the C08 cursor x byte is 9; 1.8.9 rounds once after the double subtraction and sends 8.
